rules: Every file used in a course has rights metadata and an attestation, or is listed here with its licence.
Nothing is downloaded automatically. A stock clip is added only after a person watched it, checked the movement and the licence page, and recorded both below.
Stock and generated media show 'Demo media — movement not yet expert reviewed' until a SEDENS reviewer approves the movement.
Generated video (Higgsfield or any other generator) is never approved automatically.
Social media, video sites and search results are never sources.
